subject: CALL statement
notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB133 wave C2a): with the AS NESTED callee's header at bind, an EXPLICIT BY CONTENT / BY REFERENCE argument whose corresponding formal is BY VALUE draws COBOL1687 citing the rule. A keyword-less argument DERIVES its mode from the formal (GR9, PB131) and can never disagree - only a written phrase can, which is why the check needs no runtime half for the NESTED lane. The prototype lane is inexpressible until P13.
